trophies.missable_reason: Not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns later and you can return for the rest (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first to destroy the safe. The 3 items are a luxury watch in the southeast office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the northeast corner, and the safe in the northeast hallway. The trophy unlocks after escaping the police. You visit here during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and items do not all need to be collected in one visit.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Profile actions accumulate through normal play and stay farmable in free-roam (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your criminal profile; check your count by clicking the trophy in the menu. Enable criminal profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile to see a small demon face when an action counts. Profiles include Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable (permanent status from excessive violence making police hyper-aggressive). Most come naturally from robberies and encounters, or can be farmed in free-roam.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_reason: The easter egg can be attempted repeatedly in free-roam; the spawn is random, not one-time (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg on the road northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, alone. The spawn is random and not guaranteed: if a blinking car is not parked at the roadside, drive away and return. Follow the path into the woods next to the car to witness the UFO (a bright blue light), approach as it drops an abducted woman, talk to her, offer help, and return to her car.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missable_reason: Registration stays available in free-roam once unlocked (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed after Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), allowing you to register stolen vehicles for delivery. Purchase enough garages first to ensure parking slots (see Little Boxes). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and select Respray and Register in his garage. Moses initially accepts untracked vehicles; from Chapter 3 you can also register tracked cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to save money.
